ctx.x: The writing of Stanley Dance has been a part of the jazz scene since the early 1930s. He was born in Braintree, England on September 15, 1910, and was attracted to American jazz by searching out the recordings that made their way to England and France. His first articles appeared in Jazz Hot and he traveled to the U.S. in 1937. Jazz lovers grew familiar with his articles and critiques as his work appeared in Down Beat, Metronome, the Jazz Journal, the New York Herald Tribune, and many other publications. His…
Stanley was interviewed in San Diego, California on February 12, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
